title: Vacations, leave and absences
description: Record requests and explicit decisions. Only approved absences block scheduling across sites. This is operational planning, not a legal entitlement or payroll calculation.
forbidden: Only managers and administrators can manage employee absences.
dateNotice: The return date is not an absence day. Maximum 366 days. Dates use the business timezone captured when the request is saved.
invalidDates: Choose valid dates, with the return date after the first day and no more than 366 days apart.
reasonLength: Enter a reason between 10 and 500 characters.
privacyNotice: Do not include diagnoses, medical records or sensitive attachments. Keep only the operational explanation needed for this decision.
formNotice: Saving a request does not approve it or alter recorded attendance, wages or existing shifts.
approvalNotice: Approval blocks new shifts for this employee during the absence, at every site. Resolve existing scheduled shifts first; none will be cancelled automatically.
loadError: Absence records could not be loaded.
saveError: The decision could not be saved. Review the request and try again.
historyNotice: Each decision retains its original explanation and period. Cancellation does not erase a previous approval.
selfApprovalNotice: Another authorized person must approve your absence.
